column1: # INV-T-5946. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-629, 975, 976, 977, 978, 979
# (read from Keel). Only INV-REQ-629 and INV-REQ-979 write any: the path `GET /v1/entities/{ref}/periods/{period}/submissions`
# (a route, not an identifier of a kind below; listSubmissions serves it) and `reporting` (a principal, the x-principal value,
# not an enum member). The rows below are therefore the operations and the fields the six requirements name in plain text,
# one row per identifier, under the first requirement that names it.
# INV-T-5952. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-554, 555, 814, 914, 917, 951, 961, 1250
# (read from Keel): confirmFiling, filedAt, irasAcknowledgementReference, portalReference, checkReadiness, plus roles, principals,
# `readiness`, the two routes), which are not identifiers of a kind below. `checkReadiness` (INV-REQ-951) is the service-side name of
# the check; the contract operations that run it are getReadiness and drainPeriod, so it has no row. Below, the rows for the backticked
# properties and operation, then the operation and the fields the requirements and the coordinator rulings (INV-Q-5948, INV-Q-5950)
# name in plain text, one row per identifier, under the first requirement that names it.

# INV-T-10712 (INV-Q-10691 A). The three schema names PendingFilingGateOverride, FilingGateOverrideList and FilingGateOverrideEntry are pinned through the schema_property rows below because the checker has no schema-name kind (a new kind is a separate tool task, INV-Q-11149 A). Backticked names of INV-REQ-1293, INV-REQ-72 and INV-REQ-500 that are not rows: `tax.approver` and `access-svc` (role and service), `AuthorityReplica.decide` and `validation.override` (library method and catalogue key; the service task INV-T-10714 owns them), `tenant.admin` (role), `authorise`, `recordSoleOperator`, `withdrawSoleOperatorAcknowledgement`, `setPolicy` and `acknowledgeControlRelaxation` (operations of the access and service-runtime contracts), `OVERRIDABLE` (a disposition value), `filing-workflow` (a principal value), and the names of INV-REQ-72 `GateMode`, `CheckVerdict`, `LatestCheck`, `FilingGate.decide`, `FilingGate.canOverride`, `REFUSAL_CODE`, `NO_BLOCK_CODE`, `STALE_CODE`, `Proceed`, `Refuse`, `Allowed`, `NoBlock`, `Stale`, `canOverride`, `decide`, `gate`, `latestCheck` and `submission-domain` (code names that INV-T-6741 owns). `confirmFiling`, `overrideFilingGate`, `filingOverride`, `ReadinessStatus.filingOverride` and `checkId` are rows already.
# INV-T-6331. `tax.operator` in INV-REQ-648 is a role and not an element of this contract.
# INV-T-6716 (INV-Q-6704 A). The rows of READY and NOT_READY for openapi.yaml already exist under INV-REQ-951; the rows below are for the payload schema.

# INV-T-6739 (INV-Q-6737 A). Identifiers overrideFilingGate, filingOverride, ReadinessStatus.filingOverride, overriddenBy, overriddenAt, reason; a row that already exists under another requirement is not added twice.
# INV-T-6947. Backticked names of INV-REQ-581, INV-AC-1774, INV-AC-1775, INV-AC-1776 that are not rows: `withdrawDocument` is the console
# operation (INV-NOTE-7 SCR-04.7) served by withdrawSubmission, owned by the console catalogue; `tax.approver` and `tax.operator` are
# roles, owned by the role registry. They are identifiers of no kind of this table.

# INV-T-12842 (INV-Q-12767 A). Backticked names of INV-REQ-1069 and INV-REQ-1070 that are not rows: `compliance-metrics.view` is a catalogue permission key (INV-T-12840, row of the role-permission table); `AuthorityReplica.decide` is a library method; `coverage`, `deadline` and `correction` are objects of ComplianceMetricsEntry and are pinned through their schema_property rows; `reporting` is a principal value; `tax.approver` and `finance.viewer` are roles.
